title: Oven Roasted Peruvian Sweet Potatoes Picarones
description: Rich and crispy Peruvian sweet potato picarones, perfect for a midnight craving, made with unsalted butter and a Jain-friendly marinade.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, lime juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and chili powder.
Add the sweet potato cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the sweet potato cubes in a single layer.
Roast the sweet potatoes in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven and use a spatula to flip them over.
Return the sweet potatoes to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
